page.layout: One page of text, single column of dictionary entries, with a centred Hebrew running head at the top and the page number at the top right. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: נְבִיאָה f. Prophetissa. נְבוּאָה f. Prophetia.
נִכְזְבָה נִכְזְ Chald. Honorarium. Et aliter, וּנְכִזְבִיתָךְ Et honoraria tua, Dan.5.17.
main_text.p: נָבַל Cadere, Decidere, Emarcescere, & de floribus ac foliis arborum emarcidis proprie dicitur, quomodo à נָפַל distinguitur: item, Stulte agere, quomodo Proverb.30.32. exponunt. Pihel נִבֵּל Vilipendit, Turpitudine affecit. Ex Hiphil Futurum, וַיַּבֵּל Et decidimus, Jesa.64.6.
נָבָל m. Stultus, Flagitiosus, Nequam; cui ratio & mens Concidit, ut stulte & turpiter agat: plur. נְבָלִים: Fœm. נְבָלוֹת.
נֵבֶל נָבֶל m. Uter, Lagena: Nablium: plur. נְבָלִים.
main_text.l: מַבּוּעַ m. Scatebra; Scaturigo: plur. מַבּוּעִים.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are only partly legible on the scan and are copied as far as they can be seen; the running head and catchword are Hebrew letters. Some Hebrew forms, especially in the entry on נבל and the Chaldee forms, may contain point errors that I could not verify.
